description: Readable 16px clues and five non-overlapping 44px gap targets plus 44px pair controls fit at 320–1440 without overflow
Selecting pairs, previewing, Clear and Escape are free and leave no preview
A wrong confirmed fit costs one attempt without consuming its pair; completing the board afterward is solved, not perfect
Nudge cancel is inert; confirmed advice costs one nudge, restores the same preview on reload and cannot be charged twice while visible
Home/End/arrows and Space preview without charging; correct placement locks a row, restores pair focus, and the pair bank remains visible while scrolling
Desktop post-placement pair focus and arrow navigation stay visible after working below the fold
Six actual correct placements win perfectly, lock all rows and return useful focus after closing the result
A completed saved game restores and repairs a missing daily result record
Real portrait and square PNG downloads carry actual aggregate scores and no answer or seed words
Reopened sharing keeps the played date after midnight; mocked file-share cancellation and denied clipboard preserve manual caption copy
Revealed Practice is explicitly shown, never perfect or solved, and leaves the Daily win intact
Real second-tab progress with delayed events discards a stale correct placement without false solve animation or announcement
No browser page errors
